name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw zero paid activity across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, making GBP the sole source of engagement with 85 total actions (including 9 calls, 53 direction requests, and 23 website clicks). The biggest movement is a 26.92% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced organic search visibility or seasonal dip in local demand with no paid support to compensate.
